split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before validation contract directory name, fixture generation metadata, replay packet, generated module output, generated manifest output, report-only row, migration-only row, or generated-output-only row
split_policy.generated_rule: all replay contracts under this root are provenance-only and have no phase support claim authority
split_policy.positive_rule: generated replay artifacts can only point back to canonical behavior owners; they never define positive parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e behavior by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: replay packets, generator labels, fixture generation metadata, generated module.ll outputs, generated module.manifest.json outputs, validation payload rows, report-only rows, generated-only rows, generated-output-only rows, generator-output-only rows, and migration-only rows stay generated replay provenance unless a canonical hand-authored fixture owner separately owns behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: runtime dispatch fallback, shim, compatibility, old-mode, unsupported, generated-only, report-only, migration-only, generated-output-only, generator-output-only, replay-only, validation-packet-only, and alternate acceptance path replay names are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.evidence_boundary_rule: parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, and e2e owners only route generated replay evidence to canonical hand-authored truth; fixture generation metadata, generated outputs, manifest outputs, report rows, replay packets, and migration rows remain separate provenance classes
